event.title: Mass Protests Erupt in Paraguay Over Banking Scandal and Impeachment of President Peña
event.canonical_title: Mass Protests Erupt in Paraguay Over Banking Scandal and Impeachment of President Peña
event.summary: Thousands of Paraguayans are protesting against a banking scandal that has left nearly half the population unable to access their savings. Demonstrators are calling for the impeachment of President Santiago Peña, who has offered to resign amid the crisis. However, Congress has put his resignation on hold as impeachment proceedings continue.

timeline.title: Protests Erupt in Manila as Women Demand Trump's Removal Ahead of ASEAN Summit
timeline.summary: On November 9, women protesters gathered in Manila to voice their opposition to Donald Trump's upcoming visit for the 49th ASEAN summit. The demonstrators carried placards reading 'Trump Out' and criticized a US-led initiative concerning semiconductors and critical minerals.
key_facts: Women protesters rallied in Manila on November 9, 2026.
The protest was in response to Donald Trump's visit for the ASEAN summit.
Protesters criticized a US-led initiative on semiconductors and critical minerals.
